tools.name: appearance_current
tools.title: Appearance now
tools.description: The desktop's look now: the wallpaper (its path), the theme (its id and name, colour, whether it was changed from the saved theme, and the look: background, borders, shadow), night light (on/off) and the top bar's style (opacity, icons light/dark, highlight, icon_opacity); also the theme colours and saved themes to choose from. Use it before changing any of them, and to answer what the desktop looks like.

tools.name: appearance_wallpapers
tools.title: Wallpapers
tools.description: The wallpapers in Settings › Background: the user's own (~/Pictures/Wallpapers, newest first) and Nightdrive's, each with path, name, group and own, and the current one. Any other image (jpg, png, webp) can be set too, such as a new one in Downloads.

tools.name: appearance_wallpaper
tools.title: Change the wallpaper
tools.description: Set the desktop's wallpaper to an image file (jpg, png or webp; an absolute path). An image from outside the wallpaper folders, such as Downloads, is copied to ~/Pictures/Wallpapers first, so it shows in Settings › Background and stays when the original is deleted; such an image must be in the folders the user lets Claude use, by the same rules as opening a file. Returns the path it set.

tools.name: appearance_theme
tools.title: Change the theme
tools.description: Switch to a saved theme (Settings › Theme › Themes): its colour and its look together. The ids are in appearance_current's themes. To change only the colour, use appearance_color.

tools.name: appearance_color
tools.title: Change the theme colour
tools.description: Change only the theme colour (Settings › Theme › Color): the highlights, borders and selections everywhere; the look (background, borders, shadow) stays.

tools.name: appearance_night_light
tools.title: Night light
tools.description: Turn night light on or off: a warm tint over the whole screen for the evening (Settings › Display).

tools.name: appearance_bar_style
tools.title: Top bar style
tools.description: Change the top bar's look (Settings › Top bar): any of its background opacity, icon and text colour (light = white, dark = black), the highlight of the active workspace (theme colour, white or black) and the icons' opacity. What isn't given stays. Returns all four as they are now.

opacity.description: The background's opacity in per cent (default 100)

icon_opacity.description: The icons' and text's opacity in per cent (default 85; at least 20, so the bar stays visible)
